body:
Source: 2026-09-20 repository maintenance audit (dead code under scripts/ and at the repo root). Related GitHub issues: #569 (the doc generator discards hand-added content; moot once the generator is gone), #861 and #852 (docs/tools mirror drift; unaffected, the mirrors stay hand-maintained). Re-verified on main @ b2b5c6ea. Five files have no live consumer.

1. `scripts/generate-tool-docs.mjs` (179 lines, single commit d82ba6c0, 2026-06-27). `git grep -n -F generate-tool-docs` prints nothing: no npm script, workflow, test or doc names it. It is destructive if run: line 7 iterates EVERY `packages/*` directory with a README (only `phaseMap`, lines 9-33, is the hardcoded 23-entry list) and line 177 overwrites `docs/tools/<pkg>.md` unconditionally. Those pages are hand-maintained mirrors. A write-free dry run at this commit: 23 existing pages overwritten (`docs/tools/gate-manifest.md` 490 -> 207 lines), 6 pages created, 4 unchanged.
2. `scripts/update-toolkit.mjs` (25 lines, same single commit). `git grep -n -F update-toolkit` prints nothing. One-shot and not idempotent: 42 of the 44 backticked `adlc <tool>` occurrences in `docs/toolkit.md` are already links, so a re-run nests a link inside each.
3. `plan.json` at the repo root (119 lines, added by afec503f with PR #967, merged 2026-09-04). Its `"base": "feat/antigravity-harness-improvements"` is not a remote head and its six ids (`t-agy-939` .. `t-agy-944`) are not in `.adlc/tickets/`. Nothing reads the root file: every `plan.json` string under `plugins/adlc-gemini/**`, at `docs/intent/booster-adoption.md:94` and at `docs/specs/fleet-orchestration.md:86` means a plan file a USER authors in their own project. Do not touch those.
4. `scripts/router/check-consolidation.mjs` (209 lines) and 5. `scripts/test/check-consolidation.test.mjs` (277 lines). The CLI has no caller; its only importer is its own test. `.github/workflows/router-drift.yml:9-14` records the intent: it is "a refactor-verification tool keyed to the pre-consolidation merge-base, not a permanent routing-freeze", intentionally not wired as a blocking merge-base comparison because that "would false-positive on any future intentional, harness-consistent routing change". The consolidation it verified merged on 2026-07-02 (0175d7d6). The test nevertheless runs exactly that comparison inside the required `scripts` segment: `AC5 integration` and `AC8 integration` (test lines 115-130) diff all six routers against `git merge-base origin/main HEAD`, and `run()` in the script (lines 134-188) has a shim for a superseded frontmatter block but none for routing, so today any PR that intentionally changes a router's phase -> `adlc <gate>` set fails `npm test` with no sanctioned override, and a router rename needed shim fields plus a main-breaking fix (7f888b87, 2026-08-06). Deleting the pair REMOVES that accidental per-PR freeze. This is the one behaviour change in this ticket and the PR description must state it. The invariants other files attribute to the check are pinned directly and stay: `scripts/test/router-drift.test.mjs` (the six routers are byte-identical to `router-model.mjs`), `scripts/test/p6-close-step-docs.test.mjs:45-46` (the Claude Code router P6 block does not grow `adlc ticket complete`), `scripts/test/codex-skill-depth-parity.test.mjs:52-55` (the codex router stays the minimal form).

CONTEXT FOR THE BUILDER. No package is involved; everything is under `scripts/`, `.github/workflows/` and the repo root. `scripts/run-tests.mjs` runs `scripts/test/*.test.mjs` as ONE glob segment (`['scripts', 'node --test scripts/test/*.test.mjs']`), so deleting a test file needs no registry edit; `scripts/test/run-tests-completeness.test.mjs` enumerates only `plugins/**/test` directories. The root `package.json` is private with no `files` list; none of the five paths appears in it, in the root `CODEOWNERS` file, in `.npmignore` or in `.gitattributes`. `scripts/test/mutation-gate.test.mjs:669-693` uses the strings `scripts/router/check-consolidation.mjs` and `scripts/test/check-consolidation.test.mjs` as SYNTHETIC file names written into a temp `fixtureRoot(...)` (lines 24-29); that test never reads the real files and stays green with them gone. None of the touched paths is trust-root tier (`packages/prosecute/lib/tier.mjs`: not in TRUST_ROOT_FILES, no enforcement or producer prefix, no active ticket rails them), and `.github/workflows/router-drift.yml` is not an immutable trust root (`.github/workflows/ci.yml` is; do not touch it).

NORMATIVE BEHAVIOUR.
1. `git rm` exactly: `scripts/generate-tool-docs.mjs`, `scripts/update-toolkit.mjs`, `plan.json`, `scripts/router/check-consolidation.mjs`, `scripts/test/check-consolidation.test.mjs`. Nothing replaces them.
2. `.github/workflows/router-drift.yml`: delete the comment paragraph at lines 9-14 ("The consolidation-equivalence module ... routing change).") and the bare `#` line 15 that follows it, so a single `#` line separates the first paragraph from the `# ====` banner. Change nothing else in the file and add no text to that comment block: the job, the `fetch-depth: 0` line and the ACTION REQUIRED banner stay. If the file no longer exists on `origin/main` when you start or rebase, skip this step. If a rebase conflicts in this file because another change reworded the same comment header, resolve by keeping the other change's wording and making sure the paragraph that names `check-consolidation.mjs` is absent; this ticket owns only that paragraph.
3. `scripts/test/p6-close-step-docs.test.mjs`, comments only. Replace header lines 6-11 with exactly the four lines between the BEGIN and END markers (verbatim, plain backticks, the first line is unchanged):
BEGIN
// It is DELIBERATELY NOT in the generated adlc-skill router (SKILL.md): that file is
// the terse phase -> `adlc <gate>` skeleton, and the completion CEREMONY is process
// detail, not a phase gate. Both directions are asserted so neither regresses:
// ADLC.md must keep the step, the router must NOT grow it.
END
Replace the three comment lines 42-44 inside the second test with exactly these two (two-space indent, the first line is unchanged):
BEGIN
  // The router's P6 routes to its gate (gate-manifest) and nothing more. The
  // completion ceremony must NOT be here: it is process detail, not a routing token.
END
Both `test(...)` bodies and every assertion (including the message text at line 46) stay byte-identical.
4. `scripts/test/mutation-gate.test.mjs`, comment only, lines 656-662: put the motivating case in the past tense and say it is gone, e.g. "The motivating case (scripts/router/check-consolidation.mjs and its same-basename test, both since removed) was fully covered, yet took the FULL-suite slow path". Do not change any fixture string, test title or assertion in this file.
5. Leave untouched even though they still name a removed file: `docs/specs/**` (including `docs/specs/router-consolidation.md`, whose AC5/AC8/AC9 verify commands are a historical record), `docs/superpowers/**`, `.adlc/specs/**`, `.adlc/tickets/**`.
6. Do NOT edit `scripts/router/router-model.mjs`. Its gemini-harness fields `baselinePath` and `supersedesBaselineFrontmatter` (lines 63-73) and the comment above them become unread, but removing them is a deletion-only edit to a surviving mutable source, and `hollow-test` exits 1 on that shape ("diff-derived file(s) produced zero mutants ... refusing to report a pass"), which turns the mutation gate red. That cleanup is a separate change.
7. No new test file. A test asserting that files stay absent pins nothing worth pinning; every criterion below is a shell check. For the mutation gate, `scripts/mutation-gate.mjs` drops deleted paths (`mutableChangedFiles`), and the surviving changed files are one workflow, two `*.test.mjs` files and the ticket shard, none a mutable source type, so `classify()` returns `kind: 'nothing'` and the gate exits 0 after listing the skipped files. That is what green means for this ticket. If the gate reports a fast or slow path instead, either a mutable source was edited by mistake (revert that edit) or `origin/main` has moved and the branch needs a rebase (the gate diffs the working tree against the base tip).

ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA.
- AC1 The five files are gone. verify: `for f in scripts/generate-tool-docs.mjs scripts/update-toolkit.mjs plan.json scripts/router/check-consolidation.mjs scripts/test/check-consolidation.test.mjs; do test ! -e "$f" || echo "STILL PRESENT $f"; done` prints nothing
- AC2 No live reference remains. verify: `git grep -n -F -e generate-tool-docs -e update-toolkit -- . ':!.adlc'` prints nothing, and `git grep -l -F check-consolidation -- . ':!.adlc'` prints exactly `docs/specs/router-consolidation.md` and `scripts/test/mutation-gate.test.mjs`
- AC3 The diff touches only the declared paths. verify: `git diff --name-status origin/main...HEAD -- . ':!.adlc'` prints exactly these 8 lines: `M .github/workflows/router-drift.yml`, `D plan.json`, `D scripts/generate-tool-docs.mjs`, `D scripts/router/check-consolidation.mjs`, `D scripts/test/check-consolidation.test.mjs`, `M scripts/test/mutation-gate.test.mjs`, `M scripts/test/p6-close-step-docs.test.mjs`, `D scripts/update-toolkit.mjs` (7 lines without the first if the workflow was already absent)
- AC4 The workflow no longer names the removed script and still runs the drift gate. verify: `test ! -e .github/workflows/router-drift.yml || { ! grep -q check-consolidation .github/workflows/router-drift.yml && grep -q 'gen-routers.mjs --check' .github/workflows/router-drift.yml; }` exits 0, and `git diff origin/main...HEAD -- .github/workflows/router-drift.yml | grep -E '^[+-]' | grep -v -E '^(\+\+\+|---) ' | grep -v -E '^-#'` prints nothing
- AC5 The two test files changed in comments only. verify: `git diff origin/main...HEAD -- scripts/test/p6-close-step-docs.test.mjs scripts/test/mutation-gate.test.mjs | grep -E '^[+-]' | grep -v -E '^(\+\+\+|---) ' | grep -v -E '^[+-][[:space:]]*//'` prints nothing, and `grep -n -E 'consolidation (routing )?guard|routing-freeze' scripts/test/p6-close-step-docs.test.mjs` prints nothing
- AC6 The direct router invariants still hold. verify: `node --test scripts/test/p6-close-step-docs.test.mjs scripts/test/codex-skill-depth-parity.test.mjs scripts/test/router-drift.test.mjs scripts/test/mutation-gate.test.mjs` exits 0
- AC7 The router generator is unaffected. verify: `node scripts/router/gen-routers.mjs --check` exits 0 and prints `router drift check passed — all 6 routers match the canonical source.`
- AC8 The scripts segment is green without the deleted test. verify: `node scripts/run-tests.mjs scripts` exits 0 and prints `1/1 segments passed`
- AC9 Nothing a user authors, and no router source that survives, was touched. verify: `git diff --stat origin/main...HEAD -- plugins docs apps packages scripts/router/router-model.mjs scripts/router/gen-routers.mjs` prints nothing
- AC10 The reworded comments pass the comment gate the rails-guard CI job runs. verify: `node scripts/check-reviewer-directed-comments.mjs origin/main` exits 0
- AC11 Mutation gate green, on a clean tree rebased onto current origin/main. verify: `node scripts/mutation-gate.mjs origin/main --max 12` exits 0 and its last line is `mutation-gate: no source files changed — nothing to mutate.`

OUT OF SCOPE: `scripts/opencode-install-smoke.mjs` (not dead: it is the documented OpenCode verification command and the only host install smoke missing from `scripts/run-tests.mjs` SEGMENTS; it currently exits 2 because its upstream-home sweep excludes `.adlc/tickets.json` but not the sharded `.adlc/tickets/`; wiring and repairing it is a separate change). Removing the unread `baselinePath` / `supersedesBaselineFrontmatter` fields from `scripts/router/router-model.mjs`. Deleting `.github/workflows/router-drift.yml` or editing any other workflow. Regenerating, collapsing or otherwise editing `docs/tools/**` or `docs/toolkit.md`. Editing `docs/specs/**`, `.adlc/specs/**` or any existing ticket shard.
title: scripts: delete five caller-less files (doc generator, toolkit linker, stale root plan.json, router consolidation check + test)
